title: Updating a framed list of local values
statement: For every finite list $ps$ of pairs of a natural-number index and an integer value, and every integer list $l$, updating the function represented by the zero-padded list $l$ at each index-value pair in $ps$ gives the function represented by the list obtained by applying those updates successively to $l$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list $ps$ of index-value pairs in $\mathbb N\times\mathbb Z$
